cards.hint: Focus on the learning goal described at the start
cards.quote: The Wright Way will show you the basic math and physics that led to the invention of the airplane by the Wright Brothers.
cards.stem: What will be shown about the invention of the airplane?

cards.hint: Think about travel beyond the sky
cards.quote: In the spirit of the Wright Brothers, NASA is using aeronautics technology to provide access to space.
cards.stem: What is technology being used to provide in the spirit of early flight?

cards.hint: Think about movable wings for control
cards.quote: At the front of all of the Wright brothers’ aircraft one finds the elevators.
cards.stem: What is found at the front of all early Wright aircraft?

cards.hint: Compare upward force with downward force
options: aircraft lift greater than the aircraft weight
cards.quote: The objective of this simulation is to find the flight conditions that produce an aircraft lift greater than the aircraft weight.
cards.stem: What flight outcome is the simulation trying to find?

checks.message: every quiz text length, id pattern and id uniqueness is within the frozen limits
all 4 card quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quote-verbatim)
every card's correct answer options[0] occurs in its quote after normalisation (answer-in-quote)
every card has distinct options after normalisation (options-distinct)
no stem contains its own correct answer (stem-no-answer-leak)
exactly one option per card matches the quote (one-correct)
every number in stems, options and hints appears on the cited page or in the same quote (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
